newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil - LS standoff develops.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil - LS standoff develops.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run was starting to show a standoff between buyers and sellers as crude pulls prices up, making it too expensive for refineries to run.
A 10,000 tonne parcel was sold into Germany at $124.50 fob NWE, a good price for the seller, traders said.
Cargo levels were seen a touch lower with U.S. interest understood to be shown at $120-122 fob NWE.
High sulphur straight run was seen a touch softer with an E-4 cargo done at a touch under formula +3.50.
Straight run in the Med was thinly offered although an Odessa was understood sold at yesterday high cif Med +$5.50.
